steps.text: The viewer opens the live session.
steps.criticality_reason: Entry to live session experience is required to watch the broadcast.
steps.rationale: Viewer successfully opened the live session interface at /?view=viewer with valid session context.

source_findings.finding: LiveStreamViewer mounts and initiates session read queries on valid context.

steps.text: The client requests the current session representation.
steps.criticality_reason: Fetching current session and live stream state is required to render viewer experience.
steps.rationale: Observed client issuing GET requests to /api/v1/sessions/:sessionId/live-stream/view and /state.

steps.text: The system returns the viewer-facing stream state.
steps.criticality_reason: Successful response with stream status is necessary for viewer display.
steps.rationale: Server returned HTTP 200 with streamStatus, streamVersion, sessionVersion and selfParticipant.

source_findings.finding: SessionsService viewLiveStream returns viewer role and stream version.

steps.text: The client renders the live-session experience.
steps.criticality_reason: Rendering viewer experience is the terminal step of the main flow.
steps.rationale: UI rendered player surface, participant badge 'Viewer Bob', stream status 'Stream ended', and controls.

terminal_outcome.text: The client displays the viewer actions shown by the design.

steps.rationale: Viewer clicked More button, setting aria-expanded to true.

steps.text: The client displays the viewer actions shown by the design.

steps.rationale: Menu container #viewer-session-menu rendered with items 'Playback quality' and 'Fullscreen'.
